properties.name: front build system
properties.description: Per-project build.sh (symlink → universal _engine) + build.json; 2_configs consolidates manifests/package-jsons/data-links. Archetypes: Vite, SvelteKit, Vue3-composition, Sass+esbuild, Sass+tsc, Copy, Nuxt. TS strict everywhere. build.sh build (never dev) after edits.

properties.name: shared SCSS (ITCSS)
properties.description: settings/tools/generic/elements/objects/components/utilities + mixins (mq sm|md|lg|xl, flex-center, flex-row, grid-auto-fit). HARD rule: NO inline CSS — all styling through this pipeline.

properties.name: data-links + analytics
properties.description: data-<key>.json.js wrappers expose globalThis.PORTAL_DATA[key] (CORS-safe, works under file://) — NO fetch() for JSON. Matomo container required in every HTML head.

properties.name: company sites
properties.description: leafy (3D/shaders), nexus (Vue), stark — marketing/portfolio sites with Three.js shaders + SCSS.

properties.name: portals
properties.description: cloud (the cloud portal, vanilla+Vue), linktree + linktree_mindmap + linktree_pixel-world, myprofile (SvelteKit).

properties.name: personal data apps
properties.description: myAstro (Nuxt), myfeed (Vue); my-fin, myhealth-{profile,tracker,feedyourself}, myid, mymaps-mytrips (Vue), myphotos; myMoments. Read personal/cloud data via PORTAL_DATA.

properties.name: finance lab tools
properties.description: central_bank, fin-terminal, market_watch, news, sailytics — financial dashboards/terminals.

properties.name: suite + cloud-facing
properties.description: json-vision (Vue), mymail, mymaps-{maps,navigation} (SvelteKit), suite; api, mcp-api-swagger, skills_mcp — front for the cloud APIs/MCPs.

properties.name: PORTAL_DATA / front-data
properties.description: data-<key> payloads consumed at runtime; some from cloud-data.
